claims.description: Implied ownership of the Lakes is attributed to residents of the neighborhoods lining the study area because of immediate proximity.

claims.description: Residents have co-opted lake edges into private gardens, reserves, and boat launches, which can create charm and cultural integrity but also create issues for lake operations, maintenance, and adjacent property owners.

claims.description: The master planning process made every effort to ensure that residents along the Lakes were engaged and that this sense of ownership is preserved in the Master Plan.
claims.name: made every effort to ensure residents along the Lakes were engaged
